# Mellow Fellow
> Official hemp-derived vapes, live resin carts, gummies & THCa flower. South Florida. Ships USA-wide. Adults 21+ only.

## About
Mellow Fellow is a South Florida-based hemp-derived cannabis brand founded in 2019 by a PhD chemist, a licensed pharmacist, and cannabis industry entrepreneurs. The team spent two years (2019–2021) on formulation science before launching, pioneering mood-specific cannabinoid blending — each product targets a specific experience rather than a single compound. In 2022, Mellow Fellow launched the M-Fusions line and expanded into rare cannabinoids (THCp, THCh, THCa). The brand specializes in the Destination Series — 18 curated blends (Euphoria, Dream, Creativity, Introvert, Tranquility, Desire, Charged, Recover, Motivation, Wanderlust, Clarity, Laughter, Grounded, Connection, Adventure, Harmony, Limitless, Passion). Partners: Arvida Labs (formulation science), Florida Healthy Alternatives Association (compliance), Good Fellows Coalition (community advocacy). All products are Farm Bill compliant and third-party lab tested by ISO-accredited laboratories. 250+ SKUs across 7 categories.
